title: Jewish Movements: Orthodox, Conservative, Reform — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Modern Judaism spans Orthodox, Conservative, and Reform movements, differing on Jewish law and modernity. Orthodoxy holds law as binding and unchanging, while Reform emphasizes individual autonomy. This overview edition presents Jewish Movements: Orthodox, Conservative, Reform within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.

spec.overview: Modern Judaism spans Orthodox, Conservative, and Reform movements, differing on Jewish law and modernity. Orthodoxy holds law as binding and unchanging, while Reform emphasizes individual autonomy.
sacred_texts: Shared Tanakh; differing responsa and platforms
spec.adherents: Movements divide affiliation, especially in the United States.

example.fact: Reconstructionist and Humanistic Judaism are smaller additional movements.

spec.study_note: Core facts verified from public sources; adherent figures are estimates from the Pew Research Center.
